sloka: ब्रह्म विद्भिः महा भागैः ब्राह्मणैः उपशोभितम् ।तत् दृष्ट्वा राघवः श्रीमान् तापस आश्रम मण्डलम् ॥३-१-९॥
transliteration: brahma vidbhiḥ mahā bhāgaiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ upaśobhitam ।tat dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ śrīmān tāpasa āśrama maṇḍalam ॥3-1-9॥

translations.english: The illustrious, effulgent Rama saw groups of hermitages adorned with venerable brahmins, with knowledge of the Supreme Spirit. On seeing them he loosened the string of his great bow and went forward.
